login.title: Bokoti ya Mosangani ya Chaîne
login.portalName: Portal ya ba partenaires ya chaîne
login.welcome: Boyei malamu lisusu! Kota na site mpo na ko gérer ba leads na yo.
login.heroTitle: Bokola mombongo na yo ya immobilier na plomb nyonso oyo omemaka
login.heroIntro: Portal moko pona ko enregistrer ba clients na ba constructeurs, bomba crédit ya ba leads na yo pe kolanda bango tii na réservation.

register.title: Enregistrer ba leads na ba secondes
register.text: Tinda client na yo na projet oyo azali na posa na yango.

protect.title: Bobateli ya kosala ba doublons
protect.text: Plomb na yo etikalaka ya yo mpo na eleko ya libateli, yango wana moto mosusu te akoki kosɛnga kiliya ndenge moko.

track.title: Bolanda ba étapes nionso
track.text: Tala état ya lead moko na moko mpe histoire mobimba, kobanda na contact ya liboso tii na réservation.

handover.title: Crédit na tango ya réservation
handover.text: Ntango kiliya moko azali kosala buku, bapesaka plomb na motongi elongo na yo oyo okomami lokola mosangani ya source.

login.secure: Kokota na bokengi - makambo ya bakiliya na yo etikalaka na yo moko

signup.title: Enregistrement ya ba partenaires ya chaîne
signup.intro: Bosala compte na bino pona kobanda ko enregistrer pe ko gérer ba leads na bino moko.
